manifest.name: freedsh
manifest.description: FreeDSH — free-first multi-model routing, automatic fallback, safe core updates and pt-BR support for DeepSeek Harness. Installable as a DSH bundle (dsh plugin add).

bundle.text:
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CAMADA (BUNDLE) DO FREEDSH — para instalar via `dsh plugin add`
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Este é o patch aplicado quando um PERFIL lista o pacote `freedsh` em
# `dsh.profile.bundles` (equivalente ao cordis.patch.yml do overlay, com uma
# diferença: aqui os plugins são referenciados pelo NOME DO PACOTE, para o Node
# resolvê-los dentro do node_modules do perfil — em vez de caminhos absolutos
# file:/// da máquina).
#
# Instalação:
#   dsh plugin --profile web add github:marcosmmjr2023/dsh-h-v1
#   (ou, depois de publicado no npm:  dsh plugin --profile web add freedsh)
#
# O que ESTA camada traz: os plugins do painel (roteador gratuito, grupos do
# OpenRouter, filtro de catálogo/modelos, atalho e painel do FreeLLMAPI, coluna
# lateral e badge de versão com atualização segura).
#
# O que NÃO traz (de propósito): configuração de provedores/chaves, o catálogo
# customizado do provider DeepSeek oficial e a compactação — esses trechos são
# específicos de cada máquina/usuário e continuam no
# `overlay/cordis.patch.yml.win.tpl`. Copie as linhas que quiser para o seu
# `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`.

# 1) Smart Model Router: roteamento automático entre provedores (free-first),
#    cadeia de fallback e modos de custo (auto/eco/balanced/ultra).
- insert:
    - id: smart-router
      name: 'freedsh/overlay/smart-router-plugin.js'
      config:
        enabled: true

# 2) OpenRouter Enhanced: grupos "OpenRouter Free" (modelos gratuitos) e
#    "OpenRouter Pro" (escolha do provedor por modelo).
- insert:
    - id: openrouter-enhanced
      name: 'freedsh/overlay/openrouter-enhanced-plugin.js'
      config:
        enabled: true

# 3) Model Visibility: filtro do catálogo no seletor + página /models.
- insert:
    - id: model-visibility
      name: 'freedsh/overlay/model-visibility-plugin.js'
      config:
        enabled: true

# 4) FreeLLMAPI Shortcut: badge que abre o painel do gateway local (chaves dos
#    provedores gratuitos) dentro do app.
- insert:
    - id: freellmapi-shortcut
      name: 'freedsh/overlay/freellmapi-shortcut-plugin.js'
      config:
        enabled: true

# 5) Layout Panel: coluna direita com os badges, últimos arquivos modificados,
#    status do gateway e núcleo. API /api/layout-info.
- insert:
    - id: layout-panel
      name: 'freedsh/overlay/layout-panel-plugin.js'
      config:
        enabled: true

# 6) Version Badge: versão instalada, atualização segura do núcleo (instância
#    isolada), snapshots e rollback. API /api/dsh-version e /api/dsh-core.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-version-badge
      name: 'freedsh/overlay/version-badge-plugin.js'
      config:
        enabled: true

readme.section: Run DeepSeek Harness with free and low-cost AI models — with automatic routing, fallback and safe updates.
readme.text:
**FreeDSH** is the community-facing name for this repository (`dsh-h-v1`). It adds a practical distribution layer on top of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): free-model routing, a local provider gateway, a friendlier UI, pt-BR support, versioned configuration and rollback-safe updates.

> **Unofficial project.** FreeDSH is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

readme.section: Run DeepSeek Harness with free and low-cost AI models — with automatic routing, fallback and safe updates.

readme.text: DeepSeek Harness is powerful, but a daily setup can become expensive or fragile when you depend on a single model/provider. FreeDSH focuses on a different experience:

| | FreeDSH adds |
|---|---|
| 🎁 **Free-first routing** | Use FreeLLMAPI, OpenRouter `:free`, OpenCode free/zen and other configured providers before paid fallback. |
| 🔁 **Automatic fallback** | If a provider fails or becomes unavailable, the router can move to another configured option. |
| 🧠 **Task-aware routing** | `auto`, `eco` and `ultra` profiles let the router choose different model tiers for different workloads. |
| 🖥️ **Integrated panel** | Provider/router/core status, recent files and model controls in the Harness UI. |
| 🛡️ **Safer core updates** | Test a new core in a parallel instance instead of overwriting the working environment. |
| ↩️ **Rollback** | Local snapshots + git history/tags make it possible to return to a known-good configuration. |
| 🌎 **International UI** | Brazilian Portuguese, English and Chinese support, following the OS language where available. |
| 💻 **Windows + Linux** | Interactive one-line installers for both platforms. |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    U[You / DeepSeek Harness] --> R[FreeDSH Smart Router]
    R --> F[FreeLLMAPI]
    R --> O[OpenRouter :free]

Free tiers change over time. FreeDSH does **not** bypass provider terms or create free access where none exists; it integrates and routes the providers/keys you configure.

---

Open PowerShell and run:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$f=\"$env:TEMP\dsh-setup.ps1\"; irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marcosmmjr2023/dsh-h-v1/main/installer/dsh-setup.ps1 -Headers @{'Cache-Control'='no-cache'} -OutFile $f; & $f"
```

The interactive installer detects an existing installation and can install, update, preserve local configuration, manage parallel instances or open the GUI.

After installation, open a **new** PowerShell:

```powershell
dsh up          # open the GUI
dsh update      # update repo/core/overlay
dsh doctor      # diagnostics
dsh env list    # list parallel instances

Debian/Ubuntu-like systems:

```bash
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marcosmmjr2023/dsh-h-v1/main/installer/dsh-setup.sh)
```

For manual/server installation, see [docs/SERVER-MAP.md](docs/SERVER-MAP.md).

> Provider credentials stay local and must never be committed. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before exposing any FreeLLMAPI/admin interface beyond localhost.

FreeDSH also ships as a **DSH bundle**, for people who already have a working harness and only want the plugins (Smart Router, OpenRouter groups, model visibility, FreeLLMAPI shortcut, right-hand panel, version badge). No installer, no overlay copying:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:marcosmmjr2023/dsh-h-v1
```

Remove it with `dsh plugin --profile web remove freedsh`. The bundle registers plugins only — it never touches your keys, providers or settings. Requirements, what is included, where the state lives and common issues: **[docs/INSTALL-BUNDLE.md](docs/INSTALL-BUNDLE.md)**.

---

- **Smart Model Router** — free-first, task-aware model selection and runtime fallback.
- **FreeLLMAPI integration** — a local gateway for multiple free/low-cost providers.
- **UI overlay** — status badges, shortcuts and model controls inside DeepSeek Harness.
- **Safe core updater** — parallel A/B-style core instances with live progress.
- **Versioned overlay** — settings, plugins and presets managed as code.
- **Sync + rollback tools** — local snapshots, git tags/history and restore tooling.
- **pt-BR localization** — experimental DeepSeek Harness localization and translated docs.

Questions, ideas and "does this work with X?" belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/marcosmmjr2023/dsh-h-v1/discussions). Bugs and concrete proposals go to [Issues](https://github.com/marcosmmjr2023/dsh-h-v1/issues) — a minimal report (OS, PowerShell version, `dsh doctor` output) gets fixed much faster.

If you use FreeDSH and it helps you, a ⭐ on the repository helps other DeepSeek Harness users discover it.

---

1. **Free-first, not free-at-any-cost.** Respect provider terms and use paid fallback when that is the reliable choice.
2. **Never break a working environment silently.** Snapshot before replacement and make rollback practical.
3. **Credentials stay local.** Secrets, sessions and runtime state do not belong in git.
4. **Upstream first.** FreeDSH extends DeepSeek Harness; it does not pretend to be the upstream project.
5. **Community over private customization.** Reusable improvements should become documented, reviewable contributions.
